title: Ben and Meg Get a Bug
lines: Ben and Meg got a big net.
"A bug can get in it," said Ben.
Ben set the net in the mud.
Ben and Meg sit. It is fun to sit.
A big bug got in the net!
Ben fed the bug a bit of a bun.
"A bug is not a pet," said Meg.
Ben set the bug in the mud. It dug!

questions.listenFor: A big bug. The story says it. If your child is unsure, have them find the word bug and read that line again.

questions.ask: Why did Ben put the bug back in the mud?
questions.listenFor: Meg said a bug is not a pet. Listen for them linking what Meg said to what Ben did next - those two lines go together.

questions.ask: Would you have kept the bug or let it go? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine - the bug lives in the mud, or it would be fun to watch. You want a reason, not a right answer.
